statusReason: SHIPPED — data/overrides/rewards-chest-fortis-colosseum.json (14 wiki-figure tests in apps/ingest/test/rewards-chest-fortis-colosseum.test.ts). No Module:/Calculator: page exists for this source (checked directly); the 12 waves' published weighted tables ARE the complete source, each reconciling exactly to its own denominator, and ctx.wavesReached is selected by an ordinary levelAtLeast condition — no new formula was needed. What stays watchlisted: the 'guaranteed a full set before receiving duplicate Sunfire fanatic pieces' rule is shipped as a WITH-REPLACEMENT approximation (no ownershipGate), because whether that protection resets per Colosseum attempt or is a permanent account-wide guarantee is not stated anywhere checked — the armour and helm pages, the page's own full patch history, and three Jagex devblog mirrors from the release cycle, checked across two separate sessions, still unresolved either way. Quantified, not assumed small: the per-piece expected drop rate the simulator's headline numbers show is IDENTICAL under both models by symmetry; the cost is entirely in same-run joint statistics no headline number surfaces (P(a duplicate armour piece this run) ~0.20% under this approximation vs ~0.00025% true, an ~800x relative overstatement though both are absolute-tiny; P(a complete 3-piece set in one run) understated ~4.4x). If the protection turns out to be lifetime-scoped, an EXACT model via ownershipGate is directly available and should replace this approximation.
